transcript: Speaker A (Woman): Go ahead laugh now, laugh at my English all you want. It's been only fifteen days since I started using this app. Now I can speak English better than you guys. [This is SpeakX app. This is an AI powered English learning app. This helps a lot to improve our English. While you all were wasting time, I practiced English on this app for ten to fifteen minutes every day. This is an AI teacher. When I speak incorrectly, it corrects me. Now I won't be afraid. Whatever mistake I make, the AI teacher is with me. If I make a mistake, it corrects it and helps me learn. Come, try this app.] Speaker B: Hello ma'am, ನನಗೆ English ಕಲಿಯೋಕೆ help ಮಾಡ್ತೀರಾ? [Hello ma'am, will you help me learn English?] Speaker D (AI Avatar): Sure, ನನ್ನ ಜೊತೆ ನೀವು ನಿಮ್ಮ free time ನಲ್ಲಿ spoken English practice ಮಾಡಲು start ಮಾಡಿ. ಕಾವ್ಯ ತರ ನೀವು ಕೂಡ ಹದಿನೈದು ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತು ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ English fluent ಆಗಿ ಮಾತನಾಡಬಹುದು. [Sure, start practicing spoken English with me in your free time. Like Kavya, you too can speak English fluently in fifteen to twenty days.] Speaker B: Wow, ಈ AI teacher ತುಂಬಾ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿದೆ. ನಾನು ಕಾವ್ಯ ತರ English ಕಲಿಬೇಕು. [Wow, this AI teacher is very good. I want to learn English like Kavya.] Speaker A: ಈ app ನನ್ನ life change ಮಾಡಿದೆ. ಈಗ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ನನಗೆ respect ಕೊಡ್ತಾರೆ. ನೀವು ಕೂಡ SpeakX app download ಮಾಡಿ. [This app changed my life. Now everyone respects me. You too download the SpeakX app.]
